lead_headline: Three new spots open today: Tavern on Blake Street returns after $1M renovations, Swiss chocolatier Läderach lands at Cherry Creek, and Miya Moon expands Chinese tapas to Baker

restaurant.blurb: 3 leads today: Tavern on Blake Street (Five Points sports bar reopening after $1M+ repairs), Läderach (Cherry Creek Swiss chocolate), Miya Moon (Baker Chinese tapas). Week's 242 active leads: 129 openings, 113 closures.

liquor.blurb: Tenth consecutive zero-application day pushes statewide freeze to 27 days—7-day total frozen at 369 licenses, all timestamped June 14 during lone backlog release. June's count locked at 369 against typical 800+ monthly baseline. No new filings, status changes, or removals since mid-month checkpoint. System paralysis now unprecedented in dataset history, indicating structural overhaul rather than administrative backlog or seasonal lull.

reputation.blurb: +9 mentions yesterday break four-day silence, lifting 7-day count to 53 across 15 sources—flat week-over-week at 53. Denver Post holds 17 citations (32% share), tracking 1up LoDo closure and Rock Bottom's 35-year run ending. Facebook added 12, mystery domain and Reddit tied at 4 each, Hoodline contributed 2. Monthly tally climbs to 198 with week remaining. Google News RSS captured 52 of 53 discoveries (98% rate), maintaining dominant pipeline position.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends dormant stretch to fifth consecutive day, holding MTD at +25 (+1.1/day) and 90-day net at +131. Last two weeks show split pattern: June 11-18 surge delivered +16 net (23 new, 7 canceled), while June 19-23 freeze produced just +1 net (1 new, 0 canceled). Five-day stall unusual against June's early momentum, though MTD pace (+1.1/day) tracks near YTD baseline (+1.2/day) as month enters final stretch.
